128245.overview: Wanna Be Wizard is a japanese-style Action RPG based on a story of a girl willing to become a wizard. While the game features the usual RPG elements like item shops, level grinding & magic spells, battle scenes are played in beat 'em up-style.

128246.overview: Wizard Slayer is an Action game, developed by FZ Media and published by Gamepark, which was released in Korea in 2002.

128247.overview: Woody & Kunta: Treasure Island is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Gamepark, which was released in Korea in 2002.
